보이는 마감과 물리적 성질을 연결했습니다: Connecting visible finishes and physical properties
콘크리트·목재·금속·고무·천 등 15종 마감은 자체 제작한 표면 무늬와: 15 types of finishes, including concrete, wood, metal, rubber, and cloth, share self-produced surface patterns, roughness, and metallic reactions. The 22 physical surfaces explicitly specify penetration resistance, footsteps/landing sounds, impact sounds, and debris. Stronger light reflection does not increase penetration resistance. Friction is still the same on all surfaces, and we haven't added any untested slip.
정적 충돌 후보를 먼저 좁히고 시야 검사를 일찍 종료합니다. 보이지 않는: Narrow down static collision candidates first and end the line-of-sight check early. Invisible targets and unused defender weapons are excluded from the instance count, and bullet marks are drawn as a shared bundle. Prepare the shader before starting the actual targeting and hitting effects. The software renderer reduces heavy surface artifacts at low settings. The graphics level does not change collision, line of sight, or hit detection.
